Kforce has a client that is seeking a Data Scientist in Orlando, FL.

Summary:
We are seeking a Data Scientist with strong operational forecasting experience, production-grade Python skills, and the judgment to solve complex, ambiguous business problems using data and AI. This role is focused on building forecasting solutions that are used by operators. The ideal candidate understands that success is not simply producing an accurate model. It's delivering reliable, scalable forecasts, integrating them into operational workflows, and continuously improving the broader forecasting system. The position will apply advanced analytical techniques including time-series forecasting, causal modeling, machine learning, statistical analysis, and optimization to solve real-world operational challenges.

Key Responsibilities:
 
  Data Scientist will design, develop, deploy, and improve operational forecasting models at scale 
  Build production-quality Python solutions that are maintainable, testable, and extensible 
  Analyze large structured and unstructured datasets to identify trends, variability, and opportunities to improve forecast performance 
  Apply time-series forecasting, causal modeling, machine learning, statistical methods, and optimization to complex operational problems 
  Evaluate model performance and conduct error analysis to continuously improve forecasting accuracy and reliability 
  Translate forecasting outputs into actionable insights for technical and non-technical stakeholders 
  As a Data Scientist, you will use AI-enabled tools thoughtfully to accelerate analysis, development, troubleshooting, and problem solving 
  Improve the overall forecasting platform and processes, not just individual models 
  Partner with operational stakeholders to understand how forecasts are consumed and ensure solutions are practical and trusted 
 
 
  3+ years of applied experience designing, developing, and deploying analytical models, or an equivalent combination of education and experience 
  Demonstrated experience with operational forecasting in real-world, production environments 
  Experience working with SQL and large datasets. The underlying role also utilizes analytical technologies including Python, SQL, R, Azure ML, Power BI, and Tableau 
  Advanced Python skills with the ability to read, troubleshoot, extend, and maintain existing production code 
  Strong knowledge of time-series forecasting, statistical modeling, machine learning, and data analysis 
  Strong critical thinking and creative problem-solving skills 
  Strong judgment around model trade-offs and how forecasting outputs affect operational decisions 
  Ability to operate effectively when requirements are ambiguous or changing 
  Ability to communicate complex analytical findings clearly to both technical and business audiences
